supplementary_stages.declared: 2026-10-30, after live_001 recorded E1_TEST_C_s1602 as SCENE_INFEASIBLE and before any live_002 run. Supplementary stage for E1_TEST_C_s1602 only. Every rule of generalization_round1_live.json (task, controller, schedule, runtime, device policy, success criteria, classes, home_outcome, failure policy) is inherited unchanged except the launch preflight geometry below. The live_001 result of this sample stays SCENE_INFEASIBLE and is reported as such; live_002 is a separate, labelled result.
supplementary_stages.reason: live_001 used the runner's default C2 plan preflight, which models all protrusions as one convex hull ('static_workpiece_bump') for the whole plan. For the three-protrusion Test C scene that hull bridges the gaps between protrusions and keeps the protrusions already removed, so it refused the plan with blade vs bump -8.4 mm at PRE_CUT:p2 (contact_free; artifacts/wp11/phaseE/round1_live_001/E1_TEST_C_s1602/run_001/plan_preflight.json). The round file already declares the geometry for scenes with two or more protrusions (configs/wp11/generalization_round1.json stages.stage1_geometry: generalization.staged_preflight); the live_001 declaration did not carry that rule over. That was a declaration omission, not a property of the scene: the same staged check PASSes on the live task (binding blade_collision slack +0.05 mm, the same thresholds).

preflight.text: Before launch, generalization.staged_preflight (round file stages.stage1_geometry: the same dense IK chain from q_home over the full live plan HOME -> ... -> RETURN_HOME, checked in contiguous chunks against the declared workpiece without the protrusions removed by earlier remove operations; remaining protrusions keep the C2 hull; same C2 thresholds; joint continuity over the whole chain) on the compiled live task must PASS; its receipt is written to inputs/staged_preflight.json. The Native runner is then launched with --skip-plan-preflight (its default single-hull preflight is replaced, not added). A FAIL is SCENE_INFEASIBLE / IK_FAILURE by generalization.classify_preflight and nothing is launched.
